fix.delta: care: after 5 prior fix records (2026-08-15 through 2026-08-28), the lenient re-parse pass remains unpromoted to engine code. The floor is unchanged: llama3.2:3b at 0.035 (114/200 unparsed), sov6-logic-v3-light at 0.105 (133/200 unparsed), sov6-synthesis-v3-light at 0.160 (123/200 unparsed), sov6-relationality-v3-light at 0.120 (116/200 unparsed). Honest fix for this cycle: add a per-model unparsed-rate column to the status output so the parse-noise floor is visible without running diagnose; gate the CareBench publishing threshold at <30% unparsed-rate — models above this threshold should be marked PARSE-GATED not MEASURED. This is a measurement-integrity fix, not a capability fix: we are not wrong about llama3.2:3b's care capability, we are wrong to quote 0.035 as a measured result when 57% of its outputs were not parseable. The number we should quote is: 0.035 at 43% parse-rate — a qualified floor, not a capability floor.
